snippet.title: Betrayal Banquet | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Betrayal Banquet, a medieval multiplayer party game where cooking, teamwork, and betrayal collide.

● Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4024990
● Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/D5MD8FhC5Q

Prepare royal feasts, serve the kings, uncover hidden Betrayers, or become one yourself !
